public_payload.normalized_proposition: By proclaiming that LLMs would change the world imminently, doomers contributed to the growth of LLM companies and to the White House thinking LLMs were critical to the nation's survival.

statement.excerpt: By proclaiming that LLMs would change the world, and that they would do so imminently, doomers contributed to the growth of the LLM companies (essentially free publicity) and to the White House thinking LLMs were critical to the survival of the nation.

from_speaker: By proclaiming that LLMs would change the world
doomers contributed to the growth of the LLM companies
the White House thinking LLMs were critical to the survival of the nation
our_interpretation: The plain reading requires a real contribution to both company growth and White House national-security beliefs, not that doomer advocacy was the sole or main cause.
Company growth is read as business expansion; the claim supplies no particular financial metric.
The White House language is read as treating leadership in advanced AI as vital to national security.
The relevant effects must have occurred by the post date. The context does not supply an exact starting date.
criteria.support_condition: Decision records, attributable testimony, or credible research connect imminent-transformation advocacy by identifiable doomers to both company expansion and the White House's national-security prioritization of LLMs.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible causal evidence rules out a contribution to at least one of the two claimed effects. Evidence of other contributing causes alone is insufficient.
